display.purpose: Application identity, panel headings and live metrics.

body.purpose: Configuration fields, recovery copy and paths.

shadows.name: overlay-window
shadows.purpose: Only for the interactive overlay preview window.

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: Live status dot only; disabled with reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #6df18b; border-radius: 3px; background: #6df18b; color: #07130e; font: 700 12px Manrope, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d7ffe1; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6df18b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: Compact editable value inside the continuous control pane.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid #2a513c; border-radius: 3px; background: #091912; color: #e5eee6; font: 500 12px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #417c59; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6df18b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Persistent section navigation for the race-control workspace.
components.css: .ds-nav, .ds-nav-active { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-left: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: #91ab99; text-align: left; font: 600 16px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-nav:hover { background: rgba(109,241,139,.06); color: #e5eee6; } .ds-nav-active { border-left-color: #6df18b; background: rgba(109,241,139,.12); color: #6df18b; }

components.name: Surface Selector
components.description: Selects the transparent overlay window currently under configuration.
components.css: .ds-surface-active { display: grid; gap: 2px; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #6df18b; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(109,241,139,.12); color: #6df18b; text-align: left; font: 600 12px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-surface-active small { font: 600 11px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-surface-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6df18b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Live Status
components.description: Explicit host liveness state, using text and a green signal dot.
components.css: .ds-status-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 27px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #1a9e54; color: #6df18b; font: 600 12px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-status-live i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6df18b; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(109,241,139,.85); }

narrative.overview: HashOverlay Settings is a low-light operations console for configuring and operating race telemetry surfaces. Continuous panes, a persistent control rail, and green operational state replace generic dashboard cards.
keyCharacteristics: Green carries live state and commitment

rules.name: The Signal Budget Rule
rules.body: Green carries state and commitment. Do not use it as a generic decoration, broad background wash, or substitute for hierarchy.

rules.name: The Control Label Rule
rules.body: A label must name a state, value, or action. Do not add decorative eyebrows above headings.

rules.name: The One-Window Rule
rules.body: Soft shadow belongs only to the overlay preview or a genuinely elevated transient surface, never to every configuration group.

dos: Do use Signal Green only for live, selected, focused and primary-action states.
Do keep high-density controls in continuous panes separated by one-pixel rules.
Do preserve native controls, keyboard focus and explicit stopped/live copy.
donts: Don't return to paper grounds, cobalt panels or acid-lime card highlights.
Don't use same-sized floating cards as the default page structure.
Don't add decorative eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use neon glows, gradients, glass or motion as generic tech styling.
